map.分辨率不够或没加窗函数会导致泄漏。增大 fftSize 可提高频率分辨率（但时间: Insufficient resolution or a missing window function causes leakage. Increasing fftSize raises frequency resolution (at the cost of time resolution), and applying a Hann or Hamming window suppresses edge discontinuities so the spectrum looks sharper.
map.可能是极小幅度的超声波段或相位抵消在单声道显示时被平均，也可能是波形纵轴缩放在满: It may be that a very small ultrasonic band or a phase cancellation is averaged out in the mono display, or that the waveform vertical axis is scaled to full range while the signal is very small. Zoom the vertical axis or switch to the spectrum view to cross-check.

map.：在 Web Audio 中用 AnalyserNode 取数据：设 fftSi: : in Web Audio, data comes from an AnalyserNode. With fftSize=2048 the number of frequency bins is 1024, and the frequency resolution is sample rate / fftSize = 44100 / 2048 ~= 21.5 Hz per bin. Applying a Hann window reduces spectral leakage. The time-domain waveform directly shows the amplitude of each sample (-1 to +1), and the vertical axis is usually shown in dB or linear amplitude.
